title: 2001 Prairie's stone-fronted corner house on 20th Street, built on the house kit
items: 2001 Prairie Avenue, the corner house on 20th Street, is no longer a rough draft: it now has two and a half storeys with a light stone front, a hipped roof with a dormer for the half storey, and a stoop at the corner end of its front.
Its outline is now read from the 1911 fire-insurance map at full size. The house is about 19 m deep, not the draft's 15 m. Its back part steps out to the 20th Street line, as the map draws it.
